text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: a piece of cake.
explanation: A piece of cake describes a task that is very easy to do.

text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: break the ice.
options: Start a conversation in an awkward setting
explanation: To break the ice is to say or do something that eases the tension when people first meet.

text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: once in a blue moon.
explanation: Once in a blue moon means something that happens very rarely.

text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: hit the nail on the head.
explanation: To hit the nail on the head is to describe a problem or situation exactly right.

text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: spill the beans.
explanation: To spill the beans is to let out a secret by accident or on purpose.

text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: under the weather.
explanation: If you are under the weather, you feel a little ill.

text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: cost an arm and a leg.
explanation: Something that costs an arm and a leg is extremely expensive.

text: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: burn the midnight oil.
explanation: To burn the midnight oil is to stay up late working or studying.

text: Choose one word for: a person who loves books.
explanation: A bibliophile is a lover of books. A bibliographer lists books, and a librarian looks after them.

text: Choose one word for: a person who walks in his sleep.
explanation: A somnambulist walks while asleep. An insomniac cannot sleep.

text: Choose one word for: the study of birds.
explanation: Ornithology is the study of birds. Entomology is the study of insects.

text: Choose one word for: present everywhere at the same time.
explanation: Omnipresent means present everywhere. Omniscient means all-knowing and omnipotent means all-powerful.

text: Choose one word for: a speech delivered without preparation.
explanation: An extempore speech is given on the spot, without preparing it beforehand.

text: Choose one word for: an abnormal fear of closed spaces.
explanation: Claustrophobia is the fear of enclosed places. Acrophobia is a fear of heights.

text: Choose one word for: a person who does not believe in the existence of God.
explanation: An atheist does not believe that God exists. A theist does believe.

text: Choose one word for: a child who has lost both parents.
explanation: An orphan is a child whose parents are both dead.
